names.th: อิคิริงโกะ

description.fun: A rowdy city parrot with a punk's pompadour. Squawkabilly form noisy flocks of 50 or more by feather colour and squabble over territory, and the mornings and evenings when they go out looking for food get very loud. Green ones hold the most sway, since that colour is the most likely to be passed down. It's modelled on the monk parakeets that flock in Madrid and other Spanish cities.
description.guide: A Normal and Flying-type parrot Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, based on the monk parakeet. It comes in green, blue, yellow and white plumage, and each colour forms its own flocks. Paldea's flying taxis are carried by Squawkabilly.
description.tagline: A punk parrot that runs with a noisy flock

description.fun: The second most common colour. Blue flocks can be over 50 strong, and they see the green-feathered majority as their rivals.
Hotheaded and vicious, yellow Squawkabilly leap in close to fight and have even driven other bird Pokémon out of town, all to be taken seriously by the more numerous colours.
The rarest colour, mellow and keen to avoid fights, though valiant when it has to. White Squawkabilly hate being alone, and they live easily in towns by blending in with the white buildings.
